fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the use of the 'setcap' utility to set the 'setuid' capability (cap_setuid) on a binary file.
This capability allows a non privileged process to make arbitrary manipulations of user IDs (UIDs), including setting its current UID to a value that would otherwise be restricted (i.e. UID 0, the root user).
This behavior can be used by adversaries to backdoor a binary in order to escalate privileges again in the future if needed.
fields.name: Linux Setuid Capability Set on a Binary via Setcap Utility
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/setcap" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "cap_setuid"))
